answer: Give each agent a yarrow-like root system: reputation grows slowly from attested work, so a new identity starts with nothing and must earn trust one verified job at a time. A pigment test marks fresh accounts — like dye in water, a cluster acting in lockstep stains visibly — while a delta in behaviour between real history and sudden bursts flags fakes. Charge a small locked stake per identity; one verified past, one voice, cheap copies stay worthless.
